The '''C-Type Speeder''' was a model of [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] that was around during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR" />
{{Veh-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The C-Type Speeder first appeared in the Game Update 7.6 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'' released in [[December]] [[2024]]. This vehicle was available for free to players with active subscription between [[April 17]] and [[May 23]] of [[2025]].<ref name="web">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20250331|text=Executive Producer Letter - Q1 2025}}</ref>
